PAGE-009.summary: Time display: while script runs, the page's generation time shows a relative label, with the absolute time in the configured timezone and its UTC offset in its tooltip and the ISO 8601 instant in its datetime; the initial HTML, script-disabled readers and incident, maintenance, feed and notification timestamps keep the absolute display (owner S4, 20 October 2026).
PAGE-009.was: Time display: Every timestamp on a public surface or in a notification is rendered in the page's configured timezone with its UTC offset, and every timestamp on the page carries the same instant as an ISO 8601 value in a machine-readable attribute.
PAGE-009.now: Time display: Every timestamp on a public surface or in a notification is rendered in the page's configured timezone with its UTC offset, and every timestamp on the page carries the same instant as an ISO 8601 value in a machine-readable attribute. Owner exception (S4, DIVERGENCE.md "Public page clarity — owner L10, 20 October 2026"): while script runs, the page's generation time shows a relative label, refreshed while the page is open. Its tooltip gives the absolute time in the configured timezone with its UTC offset, and its `datetime` keeps the ISO 8601 instant. The initial HTML and script-disabled readers see the absolute time. Incident, maintenance, feed and notification timestamps keep the absolute display.

UPTIME-003.summary: Short history: the figure is labeled with its coverage, elapsed hours and minutes while it covers less than one whole day ("less than 1 minute" below a minute) and whole days from one day onward, and a component with no data says No data (owner S4, 20 October 2026).

UPTIME-003.now: Short history: A component whose earliest state history entry is later than the start of the reporting window shows uptime computed from that entry, and the page labels the figure with the coverage: elapsed hours and minutes while it covers less than one whole day ("less than 1 minute" below a minute), and whole days from one day onward.
